about: Apple Music in the Compass (COMPASS.md §2e) on the running dev app. The desk test's 9 steps; step 8 (signed out) is a forced failure of `catalog_search` (the same no-chip path), the real sign-out stays a hand test. `catalog_search` calls are counted by the runner (window.__shotsInvoke.calls), as deltas from a mark before each step.
pass: The shot is ok: every probe's `expect` holds. Terms: 'Fleetwood Mac' and 'Portishead' and 'Boards of Canada' and 'Massive Attack' are not in his library; 'kwes' is. A term already asked this app session is cached, so a rerun needs a dev app restart (or new terms) for the steps that expect one call.
run: node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/compass-apple.json (dev app on screen, signed in, Search in slot d). It plays one catalog song (step 7): pause the dev app after.

4a. the calculator: no chip, no call
4b. a command: no chip, no call

steps.probe: (() => { window.__mark(); const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] input.search__input'); window.__sOld = i.value; i.value = 'Aphex Twin'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] input.search__input'); i.value = ''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); i.blur(); return true; })()
